t: The Infinity Hammer is a tool that allows you to damage enemies in an area. Increasing the tier will give you access to different levels of $(6)Beheading$(), allowing you to get mob heads easily.
无限战锤是一种可以对一片区域内敌人造成伤害的工具。提升等级可让你获得不同等级的 $(6)斩首$()，从而更容易获得生物头颅。
When right clicked into the ground it will make a $(6)shatter$() effect into the ground in a cone shape in front of the user.
右键点击地面时，会在玩家前方以圆锥形对地面产生$(6)粉碎$()效果。
